name: Multi Measure Trend
description: Several measures over time on one chart. Each measure can be a solid, dashed or dotted line, an area or bars, with its own color and axis, plus a tooltip comparing them.

encodings.name: Date
encodings.tooltip: A date or period: MONTH(Date), DAY(Date), or a discrete period. Every measure is plotted against it.

encodings.name: Measures
encodings.tooltip: One or more measures or calculations, each becomes its own line, area or bars. Style each one in Format Extension → Measures.
